title: Unsolvability Ceiling in Multi-LLM Routing: An Empirical Study of Evaluation Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2605.07395v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient routing across multiple LLMs enables cost-quality tradeoffs by directing queries to the cheapest capable model. Prior work attributes routing headroom to an "unsolvability ceiling", queries no model in the pool can solve. We present a large-scale study of multi-tier LLM routing with 206,000 query-model pairs across six benchmarks (MMLU, MedQA, HumanEval, MBPP, Alpaca, ShareGPT) using the Gemma 4 and Llama 3.1 families. Evaluating with both LLM-as-a-judge and exact-match metrics, we show that a substantial portion of reported unsolvability stems from evaluation artifacts: (i) systematic judge biases favoring verbosity over correctness, (ii) truncation under fixed generation budgets, and (iii) output format mismatches. Through dual-judge validation and exact-match grounding, we reduce measured unsolvability across tasks. translated_title: 多LLM路由中的不可解性上限：评估伪影的实证研究
translated_abstract: 跨多个大语言模型的高效路由通过将查询导向最便宜的、能力足够的模型，实现了成本与质量的权衡。先前的工作将路由的提升空间归因于一种“不可解性上限”，即模型池中没有任何模型能够解决的查询。我们对多层LLM路由进行了一项大规模研究，使用Gemma 4和Llama 3.1模型家族，在六个基准（MMLU、MedQA、HumanEval、MBPP、Alpaca、ShareGPT）上共包含206,000个查询-模型对。通过LLM-as-a-judge（大模型作为裁判）和精确匹配两种指标进行评估，我们发现所报告的不可解性中有相当大一部分源于评估伪影：(i) 系统性的裁判偏差，偏好冗长而非正确性；(ii) 固定生成预算下的截断；(iii) 输出格式不匹配。通过双裁判验证和精确匹配校准，我们降低了各任务上测得的不可解性。我们引入了一个分解框架，将失败归因于这些伪影，揭示了一致的
tldr: 该大规模实证研究（206,000个查询-模型对、六个基准）发现，多LLM路由中报告的“不可解性上限”很大程度上是评估伪影（裁判偏差、截断、输出格式不匹配）造成的，并提出分解框架对失败原因进行归因。
en_tdlr: A large-scale empirical study across six benchmarks and 206,000 query-model pairs shows that much of the reported "unsolvability ceiling" in multi-LLM routing stems from evaluation artifacts (judge bias, truncation, and format mismatches), and introduces a decomposition framework to attribute failures to these artifacts.
